subject: Energy
title: Smart Homes and Demand Response
description: A fast breakdown of Smart Homes and Demand Response for builders.

hook.text: Smart homes shift energy use automatically—charging EVs at night, running dishwashers at noon, pre-cooling before peaks.

buildup.text: Smart thermostats, timers, and EV chargers respond to grid signals—using power when it's cheap and clean.

discovery.text: Demand response programs pay consumers to reduce peak use—cutting their bills while helping stabilize the grid.

twist.text: Millions of coordinated devices act like a virtual power plant—avoiding the need to build peaking gas plants.

climax.text: In Texas, Tesla Powerwalls collectively discharged 80 MW during a 2023 heat wave—homes helping the grid survive.

punchline.text: Your fridge helps the grid—smart demand is invisible power.

quiz.question: What is a virtual power plant?
options: Coordinated devices that reduce or shift demand collectively
